reviews.title: What Happened to the Weather?
reviews.text: This app started out great. And for some unknown reason, it no longer shows the correct temperature. I use my town and a neighboring town, and both of them say it is 66° every day, all day long. It is impossible to change this – and I don’t know why it is hung up on that temperature when every other weather app displays the correct temperature.

reviews.title: Annoying wallpaper / weather does not update
reviews.text:
Weather+ looks stylish, but the incessantly fast-moving background gets on my nerves. 
The most annoying thing is that the app does not seem to update the weather it displays. But rather, checks the weather once when it loads, and then only updates the clock. To update the weather, I have to shut the app down, close it by swiping up, and restart. Not what I wanted.
They do not seem to respond to bug reports.

Sad to say I won’t be renewing. There has to be better out there unless these people reach back out to me… Hello?
